priority_order: then investigate the separate no-accepted-source queue
rules: Resolve the existing review-candidate queue before spending effort on cases with no accepted source.
Preserve every published FeO determination; do not average values.
Accept a value only when the source identifies the exact sample or a documented fraction/split that can be linked to it.
Do not promote mineral, glass-coating, clast, or other component values to parent-bulk ground truth.
If a table combines soil and boulder/component columns, exclude values explicitly assigned to the other material.
Google/AI summaries are discovery leads only and are not accepted without primary-source verification.
Record incidental Al2O3, age, and maturity only when encountered during FeO verification; do not broaden the search solely to find them.
